judge_input.description:
<!-- Each PR needs an open issue unless it's a docs fix; else create one first. -->

> Which issue, if any, is this issue related to?

Similar to https://github.com/stylelint/stylelint/pull/9061

> Is there anything in the PR that needs further explanation?

Changes the rule to only call `fork` if the `*syntax` secondary options are used, or if the linted file contains `@property` at-rules extending the syntax; otherwise it uses the cached lexer from `context`.

I'll open an issue to remove the (now redundant, since we added `languageOption`) secondary options, leaving only the more performant `languageOption`. Forking on new definitions in a file seems unavoidable, though.

Benchmarked using our standard config:

```
export default {
	extends: ['stylelint-config-standard'],
};
```

Nearly halves the time on 1000 CSS files (Small −22.0%, Medium −37.7%, Large −44.1%, X-Large −45.8%). Cumulative gains combined with https://github.com/stylelint/stylelint/pull/9061: Small −40.2%, Medium −60.9%, Large −70.8%, X-Large −75.6%.
judge_input.title: Fix `declaration-property-value-no-unknown` performance
